newsitem.title: USA: Dollar Tree to offer 3.5 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Dollar Tree to offer 3.5 million shares.

text.p: Dollar Tree Stores Inc said Tuesday it intends to file a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed public offering of about 3.5 million shares.
The shares, to be offered on or about June 9, would include about 2.35 million shares offered by the SK Equity Fund LP and certain of its affiliates, Dollar Tree said in a news release.
Another 1.15 million shares would be offered by founding Dollar Tree shareholders and certain of their affiliates, the company said.
Dollar Tree is a discount variety store chain.
